installFromMenu: Choose Install in your browser menu or Add to Home Screen from Share.
privateHint: Your account data is available after you sign in.
title: Agents that keep the conversation going.
heroSummary: One continuing conversation for every Agent. Bring people, computers and tools into a Space, and pick up your work on Web, Desktop or Mobile.
previewPrompt: Review the release notes and prepare a checklist.
previewReply: I’ll keep the checklist in a Page so we can continue from it next time.
previewNotice: Static examples throughout this page. No messages are sent and no tools are run.
stepSpaceHint: Create a Space for your work and invite the people who belong there.
stepAgentHint: Set its instructions, choose an available model and enable the resources it needs.
stepConversationHint: Send a message, review actions and keep the results. Return to the same conversation or schedule the next Run.
capabilitiesTitle: A place for the whole piece of work.
capabilitiesHint: From the first message to the next scheduled Run, keep the context, controls and results together.
previewQuestion: What would you like to work on?
previewScreen: Optional Screen · view or take control
previewProtected: Protected input · used once, outside chat
sharedHint: Give each persistent Agent its own instructions, model and continuing conversation. Invite members to a Space, bring Agents into groups, and share files and notification updates.
computersHint: Use a Space sandbox with durable files and, when configured, Screen viewing and member takeover. Or connect your own device and confirm a directory locally. Device commands use your OS permissions; device Screen is unavailable.
approvalsHint: Ask before changes, set exact Allow/Block rules, or use configured Auto review. Give protected input once in a separate form. Device commands still require your approval or an exact Allow rule.
routinesHint: Schedule in a time zone, run a routine now, or use configured webhook, email and repository-event triggers. Follow each occurrence through its Run history.
knowledgeTitle: Keep what the next conversation needs.
knowledgeHint: Maintain versioned memory for an Agent or its Space. Create Markdown or HTML Pages, review versions, restore earlier work and share revocable links.
toolsHint: Add text skills, remote HTTP MCP servers and Space-owned HTTP API tools. Choose which resources an Agent can use; tool credentials stay on the server.
clientsHint: Accepted Runs continue on the server when you close a client. Reconnect to their committed progress and results.
clientWebHint: The full workspace, Page and tool management, and administration. Responsive layouts include phone browsers.
clientDesktopHint: The shared workbench with native device-directory confirmation. Page previews open in Web.
clientMobileHint: Native conversations, groups, approvals, routines, memory, attachments and notifications. Use Web for Screen and full Page/tool management.
hostingHint: Self-host Raypx and configure your models, tools and computers. Space membership controls access; deployment operators control stored conversation content. Sandbox isolation depends on host configuration. Your own device retains its OS permissions.
securityHint: Protected input stays outside chat and model history. Output echo scrubbing is best effort. Context and memory never grant permission.
authTitle: Come back to work that remembers.
authSummary: Your Agents, conversations and shared Spaces stay together across clients.
authFactAgents: Continue with persistent Agents, memory and versioned Pages.
authFactControl: Use configured computers and tools with explicit action controls.
authFactTogether: Share a Space and let routines carry recurring work forward.
hostingSetupHint: The first account becomes the deployment administrator. Email setup can wait.
